href="/css/style.css"

=== fetch a bundle ===
bundle:

observation.command: echo "=== admin-front bundle refs ==="; curl -s --max-time 10 http://localhost:8082/ | grep -oE 'src="[^"]*\.js"|href="[^"]*\.css"' | head; echo "=== fetch a bundle ==="; B=$(curl -s --max-time 10 http://localhost:8082/ | grep -oE '/static/js/[^"]*\.js' | head -1); echo "bundle: $B"; if [ -n "$B" ]; then curl -s -o /dev/null -w "bundle HTTP %{http_code} size %{size_download}\n" --max-time 15 "http://localhost:8082$B"; fi
